Deviload on Linux, and one update for every system.

**Windows:** `Deviload-2.2.0-setup.exe`, or accept the update prompt in the app.

**Mac (test build):** `Deviload-2.2.0-macos-test.zip`, unzip, move to Applications and run `xattr -cr /Applications/Deviload.app` once. From this version on, the Mac app updates itself from inside the app.

**Linux (x86_64):** `Deviload-2.2.0-amd64.deb` for Debian and Ubuntu (`sudo apt install ./Deviload-2.2.0-amd64.deb`), or `Deviload-2.2.0-x86_64.AppImage` for any distribution. The AppImage updates itself.

What's new

- Linux builds with yt-dlp, FFmpeg and Deno inside
- The Mac app and the AppImage now update themselves in one click, like Windows; one release updates all three systems

Full changelog: https://github.com/Pronexsteam/deviload/compare/v2.1.0...v2.2.0
